defs.en: ...because it has already been mentioned, is to be completely specified in the same sentence, or very shortly thereafter.
defs.ex: I’m reading the book Mary reviewed. (Compare I’m reading a book Mary reviewed.)

defs.en: Used before a noun designating something considered to be unique, or of which there is only one at a time.
defs.ex: No one knows how many galaxies there are in the universe.

defs.en: Used to indicate a certain example of (a noun) which is usually of most concern or most common or familiar.
defs.ex: No one in the whole country had seen it before.

defs.en: Used before a body part, a family member, a pet (especially of someone previously mentioned), as an alternative to a possessive pronoun.
defs.ex: A stone hit him on the head. (= “A stone hit him on his head.”)

defs.en: Precedes a familiar nickname or other term of address.
defs.ex: How's the Sal today?

ja: その＜話し手と聞き手が共通に理解している名詞であることを示す＞

defs.en: With a comparative, and often with for it, indicates a result more like said comparative. This can be negated with none.
defs.ex: It was a difficult time, but I’m the wiser for it.

defs.en: Beyond all others.
defs.ex: We went the furthest under her leadership.

ja: （関係副詞:比較級とともに）かえって、なおさら

defs.en: A particle used for marking the following verb as an infinitive.

defs.en: As above, with the verb implied.
defs.ex: "Did you visit the museum?" "I wanted to, but it was closed."

defs.en: Used to indicate an obligation on the part of, or a directive given to, the subject.
defs.ex: You are to go to the store and buy a bottle of milk.

defs.en: A filler word common amongst urban Indians.
defs.ex: I am to so bored right now.

defs.en: In order to.

defs.en: In the direction of; towards.

defs.en: Indicating destination or final position: In the direction of, so as to arrive at or reach.

defs.en: Used to indicate the target or recipient of an action.

defs.en: So as to contact, press against, impact, etc.

defs.en: So as to become or reach: indicating a terminal state resulting from an action.

defs.en: Toward a closed, touching, or engaging position.

defs.en: Into the wind.
Introducing a clause that is the object of a verb, especially a reporting verb or verb expressing belief, knowledge, perception, etc.

defs.en: As delayed subject.

defs.en: As direct subject.

defs.en: Introducing the complement of a mandative verb.
defs.ex: I insist that you come.

defs.en: Introducing a clause that complements an adjective or passive participle.
defs.ex: I'm sure that you are right.

（such 名詞 thatの形で） 非常に～なので

defs.ex: That book is a good read. This one isn't.

defs.en: The thing, person, idea, quality, event, action, or time indicated or understood from context, especially if more remote geographically, temporally or mentally than one designated as "this", or if expressing distinction.
defs.ex: That's my car over there.

defs.en: Used to refer to a noun phrase or statement just made.
defs.ex: They're getting divorced. What do you think about that?

defs.en: Used to emphatically affirm or deny a previous statement or question.
defs.ex: The water is so cold! — That it is.

defs.en: In a relative clause, referring to a previously mentioned noun, as subject, direct object, indirect object, or object of a preposition; which, who.
defs.ex: I didn't see the car that hit me.

defs.en: Used in place of relative adverbs such as where or when; often omitted.
defs.ex: the place that [= where or to which] I went last year

ja: （遠称）それ/あれ、その/あの（人、もの）

defs.en: Denoting an equal degree.

defs.en: Denoting 'as much', 'no less'.
defs.ex: She said we waited for three hours, but I'm sure it wasn't that long.

defs.en: To a great extent or degree; very, particularly.
defs.ex: I was seen quite quickly — I didn't have to wait that long.

defs.en: To such an extent; so.
defs.ex: Ooh, I was that happy I nearly kissed her.

ja: そんなに、あんなに（程度の差を示す)

The (thing) here (used in indicating something or someone nearby).

defs.en: Referring to oneself.
The known (thing) (used in indicating something or someone just mentioned).

defs.en: The known (thing) (used in indicating something or someone about to be mentioned).

defs.en: A known (thing) (used in first mentioning a person or thing that the speaker does not think is known to the audience). Compare with "a certain ...".
defs.ex: I met this woman the other day who's allergic to wheat. I didn't even know that was possible!

defs.en: To the degree or extent indicated.
defs.ex: I need this much water.

defs.en: The thing, item, etc. being indicated.
defs.ex: This isn't the item that I ordered.

ja: これ、この（人、もの）、こちら

defs.en: Something being indicated that is here; one of these.
Indicates the speaker's strong approval or agreement with the previous material.

defs.en: A group of entities previously mentioned.
defs.ex: Fred and Jane? They just arrived.

defs.en: One whose gender is unknown, irrelevant, or both.

defs.en: One who is nonbinary.

defs.en: People; some people; people in general; someone, excluding the speaker.

defs.en: The authorities, the (power) elites, the powers that be, the establishment, the man, the system: government, police, employers, etc.

ja: 性別が分からない、または男女どちらにも当てはまらない単数の人を指す代名詞。ただし対応する動詞は三人称複数形を取る。

defs.en: The, those.
Their.
To refer to (someone, sometimes especially someone who does not use gender-neutral pronouns) using they/them pronouns.

defs.en: A non-binary person.
Belonging to, from, of, or relating to, them (plural).

defs.en: Belonging to someone (one person, singular), or occasionally to something.
In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).
defs.ex: I know Bristol quite well as I used to live there.

defs.en: At that point, stage, etc., visualised as a distinct place.
defs.ex: He did not stop there, but continued his speech.

defs.en: In a notional place where one will provide support or care; see also be there.
defs.ex: You know that I will always be there for you.

defs.en: In existence in some place.
defs.ex: I know that aliens are there, somewhere.

defs.en: In its correct position, so as to be fully and properly fitted or inserted.
defs.ex: If I just push this in here like this, it should .... Ah! Good! It's there!

defs.en: Used to offer encouragement or sympathy; see also there, there and there now.
defs.ex: There, there. Everything is going to turn out all right.

defs.en: Used to express victory or completion.
defs.ex: There! That knot should hold.

defs.en: That place (previously mentioned or otherwise implied).

defs.en: That situation; that position.
defs.ex: You rinse and de-string the green beans; I'll take it from there.

defs.en: Used as an expletive subject of be in its sense of “exist”, with the semantic, usually indefinite subject being postponed or (occasionally) implied.

defs.en: Used with other intransitive verbs of existence, in the same sense, or with other intransitive verbs, adding a sense of existence.

defs.en: Used with other verbs, when raised.

defs.en: That.
defs.ex: therefor, thereat, thereunder

defs.en: Appended to words of greeting etc.
defs.ex: Hi there, young fellow.

defs.en: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.
defs.ex: Time stops for nobody. the ebb and flow of time

defs.en: The feeling of the passage of events and their relative duration, as experienced by an individual.
defs.ex: Time flies when you're having fun.

defs.en: A dimension of spacetime with the opposite metric signature to space dimensions; the fourth dimension.
defs.ex: Both science-fiction writers and physicists have written about travel through time.

defs.en: Change associated with the second law of thermodynamics; the physical and psychological result of increasing entropy.
defs.ex: Time slows down when you approach the speed of light.

defs.en: The property of a system which allows it to have more than one distinct configuration.
defs.ex: An essential definition of time should entail neither speed nor direction, just change.

defs.en: To measure or record the time, duration, or rate of something.
defs.ex: I used a stopwatch to time myself running around the block.

defs.en: To choose when something commences or its duration.
defs.ex: The President timed his speech badly, coinciding with the Super Bowl.

defs.en: To regulate as to time; to accompany, or agree with, in time of movement.
To measure, as in music or harmony.
Reminder by the umpire for the players to continue playing after their pause.
The umpire's call in prizefights, etc.
A call by a bartender to warn patrons that the establishment is closing and no more drinks will be served.
defs.ex: Time gentlemen please!

defs.en: by the time; once.
Used as the direct object of a verb.
defs.ex: She treated them for a cold.

defs.en: Used as the indirect object of a verb.
defs.ex: She wrote them a letter.

defs.en: Used as the object of a preposition.
defs.ex: Give it to them.

defs.en: As a grammatical subject or object when joined with a conjunction.
defs.ex: [...] and now them and the Goo Goo Dolls are playing together.

defs.en: Used in isolation or apposition, or (sometimes proscribed) as the complement of the copula (be).
defs.ex: Who was there? —Them.

defs.en: Synonym of they (“a non-binary person”).
Those.

defs.en: Used in comparisons, to introduce the basis of comparison.

ja: （形容詞・副詞の比較級に用いて）～よりも

defs.en: At that time; then.
A numerical value equal to 2; the number following one and preceding three.
Describing a set or group with two elements.
The digit/figure 2.

defs.en: A two-dollar bill.
A child aged two.

defs.en: A playing card featuring two pips.
Two o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.
To ponder, to go over in one's mind.

defs.en: To have (some statement) in one's mind; to say to oneself mentally.

defs.en: To communicate to oneself in one's mind, to try to find a solution to a problem.

defs.en: To conceive of something or someone
defs.ex: I tend to think of her as rather ugly.

defs.en: To be of the opinion (that); to consider, judge, regard, or look upon (something) as.

defs.en: An act of thinking; consideration (of something).

defs.en: At that time.

defs.en: Soon afterward.

defs.en: Next in order of place.

defs.en: In addition; also; besides.
In that case.

ja: さらに、加えて、それから。
（「if～,」等を受けて）そうしたら、そのときは。

That time.

defs.en: Likewise.

defs.en: To a high degree, very.

defs.en: Used to contradict a negative assertion with present and simple past forms of be, do, and auxiliary verbs

ja: （形容詞、副詞を修飾して）～すぎる、ひどく～である。

defs.en: To seize or capture.

defs.en: To catch or get possession of (fish or game).

defs.en: To catch the ball; especially as a wicket-keeper and after the batsman has missed or edged it.
To appropriate or transfer into one's own possession, sometimes by physically carrying off.

Money that is taken in, (legal or illegal) proceeds, income; (in particular) profits; takings.

defs.en: So as to progress within (something) or towards the end or limit of (something).

defs.en: Along the course of a task etc.; used in expressions of progress towards the end.

defs.en: By way of an opening.

Describing a set or group with three elements.
The digit/figure 3.
Anything measuring three units, as length.

defs.en: The playing card featuring three pips.
Three o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.
One's clothes, furniture, luggage, or possessions collectively; stuff

defs.en: The general state of affairs in a given context, e.g. one's relationship

Whatever can be owned.
Corporeal object.

To convey or haul with a team.

defs.en: To give work to a gang under a subcontractor.

defs.en: To multiply.

defs.en: In the current era; nowadays; these days.

defs.en: The current day or date.
